content: Kathutkung: Devit, La kahrawikung Jeduthun koe sak e la

content.text: Atangcalah ka hringnae ni Cathut teh duem a ring.
Kai rungngangnae teh ama koehoi doeh a tho.
Ama dueng doeh ka lungsong hoi ka rungngangnae lah kaawm.
Ama teh rapan lah ao, ka kâhuen mahoeh.
Bangkongmaw tami buet touh heh na uk han.
ka rawm e rapan hoi kâhuen e tapang patetlah
nâtotouh maw na raphoe awh han.
Arasangnae koehoi pabo hanelah a kâpan awh.
Laithoe deinae koe a lunghawi awh teh.
A pahni hoi yawhawi a poe awh ei teh,
a lungthung hoi thoe a bo awh.
Ka hringnae, Cathut dueng maha duem ring lawih.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ka ngaihawinae teh a ma koehoi doeh a tho.
Ama dueng doeh ka lungsong hoi rungngangnae lah ao.
Ka kâhuen mahoeh.
Ka rungngangnae hoi bawilennae teh, Cathut dawk ao.
Ka thaonae lungsong hoi ka kânguenae teh ka Cathut dawk ao.
Tamimaya, ama teh a yungyoe kâuep awh haw.
A hmalah na lungthin rabawk awh haw.
Cathut teh maimouh kânguenae doeh.
Kangduenae hmuen kârahnoumnaw ahrawnghrang lah ao awh teh,
kangduenae hmuen ka rasangnaw teh, laithoe doeh.
Yawcu hoi khing pawiteh, hotnaw teh ahrawnghrang hlak a pâhaw awh.
Rektapnae hah kâuep awh hanh.
Thama lahoi lawp e dawk kâuep awh hanh.
Hno tawnta e dawk na lungpen awh hanh.
Cathut ni vai touh a dei toe.
Apâhni bout ka thai e lawk teh, bahu teh Cathut dawk ao.
Oe BAWIPA, nang teh pahrennae hoi na kawi.
Nang ni tamipueng amamae tawksak e patetlah ouk na poe.
